title: All parts are Active at release, and switching tabs clears the selection
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. On release day, confirm every existing part is on the Active tab (none start inactive).
  2. On the Active tab, tick some rows (in bulk mode), then switch to the Inactive tab; check the selection.
  3. Apply a search, a filter and a sort on each tab and compare behaviour.
  4. View the Inactive tab in a shop with no inactive parts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every part that exists when the feature is released is active; switching tabs clears any rows the user had selected.
  • Search, filters and sort work the same way on both tabs; with no inactive parts, the Inactive tab shows an empty state (no parts listed).

Source - where this behaviour comes from
